description: Bridges is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Schweizerische Bundesbahnen SBB. A bridge is a structure that crosses a road or an obstacle. A small bridge up to 2 meters is called a passage. Bridges are represented as a complete object consisting of individual bridge construction units. Last Update Jan 2026A bridge is a structure that crosses a road or an obstacle. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Schweizerische Bundesbahnen SBB. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GPX, JSON, JSON-LD, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
